what_worked: The revenue-skew narrative (most startups are tiny) is a valid and engaging thesis.
fix_next: Charts appear fabricated—growth distribution, follower-revenue pie, and region counts lack verifiable dataset grounding; anchor every chart to real data.
verdict: Thin, largely fabricated-looking charts wrapped in motivational language.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: Title says 'AI Startups' but dataset covers all categories, not just AI; 40% US claim unverifiable and ignores 241 missing country values. Slide 3: '22.86% total conversion rate' is unexplained and unverifiable; 'Median MRR under $500' is stated as monthly but dataset is 30-day revenue (not MRR); '60% have yet to break even' is fabricated. Slide 4: Growth distribution (30/30/20/12/8) appears entirely invented—no growth-rate field exists in the reference dataset. Slide 5: Follower-vs-revenue pie chart (40/35/15/10%) has no evident dataset basis and looks fabricated.

evidence.insight: Claims stay at surface level ('most startups are small,' 'hype ≠ revenue'). No category, provider, TLD, or anonymity analysis. No original finding beyond obvious skew.
evidence.narrative: There is a loose arc (geography → revenue → growth → social → takeaway), but it reads as a list of loosely connected observations rather than a thesis-driven argument with synthesis.
evidence.framing: Title frames this as '1,000 AI startups' when the dataset spans 12+ categories. No mention of data source, missingness, or limitations. Audience is vague ('for you').
evidence.accuracy: Slide 4 growth chart appears wholly invented (no growth-rate variable in reference data). Slide 5 pie chart percentages are unverifiable. Slide 3 conflates 30-day revenue with MRR. Slide 2 ignores 241 missing country values. '22.86% conversion rate' is unexplained.
evidence.visual: Gamma template is clean but repetitive dark-mesh background adds no information. Charts are legible but suspiciously round numbers (30/30/20/12/8). Pie chart on slide 5 is a poor choice for 4 categories with no source annotation.
evidence.ai_slop: Motivational filler throughout ('The AI era is just beginning,' 'Consistency beats virality,' 'Hype doesn't pay the bills'). Round fabricated-looking chart numbers. Generic three-column takeaway cards on every slide. Decorative mesh background repeated on every page.
